items.reason: The user explicitly requires only actual hypotheses and a restrained affirmative main target, without reminders to search for missing conditions or counterexamples. This is the benchmark variable being tested. The current and preceding research cases have an empty candidate_instruction and their prompt is exactly task.md. Adding a fallback instruction would change the authorized experimental design and baseline comparability.
items.grading_contract: A complete valid impossibility argument or counterexample is fully accepted. The public evaluator protocol already states this in protocol/evaluation.md; it is not injected into candidate input. Applicable short standard-theorem routes are accepted on the same basis as longer constructive routes.
